req.title: Delete cookie via query string
req.statement: The system shall expire cookies named in the query string of GET /cookies/delete and redirect to /cookies.

doc.reasoning: The delete_cookies handler at GET /cookies/delete reads cookie names from the query string, calls r.delete_cookie(key=key) for each, and returns a 302 redirect to /cookies. Tests must verify: (1) positive – a named cookie is expired via Set-Cookie with a past date and a 302 redirect is issued; (2) negative – no query params yields a 302 with no Set-Cookie headers; (3) boundary – deleting exactly one vs. multiple cookies; (4) state-transition – cookie present before delete is absent after following the redirect; (5) decision-table – value portion of query param is irrelevant to deletion. Mutation resilience requires exact status code assertions (302 not 301/303), exact Location header value (/cookies), exact Set-Cookie expiry semantics (expires in past), and both sides of the cookie-presence boolean.

tests.name: test_delete_single_cookie_returns_302_and_expires_cookie
preconditions: Cookie 'session' is set on the client
expected: Set-Cookie header for 'session' contains an expiry in the past (expires= present)
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_delete_single_cookie_returns_302_and_expires_cookie():
    client.get('/cookies/set/session/abc', follow_redirects=True)
    r = client.get('/cookies/delete?session=', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    location = r.headers.get('Location', '')
    assert location == '/cookies'
    set_cookie_headers = r.headers.getlist('Set-Cookie')
    session_headers = [h for h in set_cookie_headers if h.startswith('session=')]
    assert len(session_headers) == 1
    header_lower = session_headers[0].lower()
    assert 'expires=' in header_lower

test_delete_single_cookie_returns_302_and_expires_cookie()

tests.name: test_delete_multiple_cookies_all_expired_in_single_request
expected: One Set-Cookie header starts with 'a=' and contains 'expires='
One Set-Cookie header starts with 'b=' and contains 'expires='
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_delete_multiple_cookies_all_expired_in_single_request():
    client.get('/cookies/set/a/1', follow_redirects=True)
    client.get('/cookies/set/b/2', follow_redirects=True)
    r = client.get('/cookies/delete?a=&b=', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    location = r.headers.get('Location', '')
    assert location == '/cookies'
    set_cookie_headers = r.headers.getlist('Set-Cookie')
    assert len(set_cookie_headers) == 2
    names_found = [h.split('=')[0] for h in set_cookie_headers]
    assert 'a' in names_found
    assert 'b' in names_found
    for h in set_cookie_headers:
        assert 'expires=' in h.lower()

test_delete_multiple_cookies_all_expired_in_single_request()

tests.name: test_delete_cookie_state_transition_cookie_absent_after_redirect
actions: Verify cookie is present via GET /cookies
GET /cookies to verify cookie is absent
expected: After delete with redirect followed: status 200
After delete: /cookies JSON does NOT contain key 'token'
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json
client = app.test_client()

def test_delete_cookie_state_transition_cookie_absent_after_redirect():
    client.get('/cookies/set/token/xyz', follow_redirects=True)
    r_before = client.get('/cookies')
    data_before = json.loads(r_before.data)
    assert data_before['cookies'].get('token') == 'xyz'
    r_del = client.get('/cookies/delete?token=', follow_redirects=True)
    assert r_del.status_code == 200
    r_after = client.get('/cookies')
    data_after = json.loads(r_after.data)
    assert 'token' not in data_after['cookies']

test_delete_cookie_state_transition_cookie_absent_after_redirect()

expected: Status code is exactly 302 (not 301, not 303, not 200)
